script_text: Taurus, this week hands you a power choice: do you protect what is yours, or transform it? Monday's Moon in your 1st House squares Pluto in your 10th, so career pressure may feel personal. Tuesday's Full Moon in Gemini lights your 2nd House of money and trines Pluto, giving you a financial decision. Wednesday is the turning point as Mercury in Sagittarius sextiles Pluto from 8th House, deepening intimacy and shared money talks. By late week, the mood softens: Thursday's Moon in Leo meets Jupiter in your 4th House, bringing family support. Sunday's Moon enters Scorpio and activates Venus, your ruler, in 7th House, romance gets real. As an Earth sign, Taurus, you thrive when desire has boundaries. Choose one financial boundary before saying yes. Wednesday is your power day because Mercury sextiles Pluto. Monday is hardest because Moon squares Pluto. Follow for daily updates.
